topics.title: Sam Kennison Details Stern Argument
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Sam Kennison recounts an argument with Howard Stern following his mother’s death. He expresses disappointment in Kennison and confirms he never had a romantic connection while referencing Donald Rice and dismissing claims of a relationship.

topics.title: Executive Rating Concerns
topics.summary: During a post-broadcast discussion, executives express anxiety about declining ratings for their late night show and attribute blame to competitor David Letterman. They discuss strategies of undermining Stern’s popularity while acknowledging potential audience shifts and expressing concerns regarding financial losses.

topics.title: Autograph Chaos and Dionne Warwick's Ostrich
topics.summary: The show details the chaotic situation surrounding a surge in autographed book orders, with fulfillment issues and confusion about responsibility. A bizarre prediction emerges: Howard believes Dionne Warwick will become pregnant by an ostrich, leading to further discussion of psychic networks and potential endorsements.

topics.title: Period Predictions and Psychic Mishaps
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss a woman’s period while exploring potential psychic abilities with age-related needs for individuals (20-70). They delve into evaluating ‘psychic readings,’ including predicting Dionne Warwick's booger fall and Linda’s movie career, offering phone call advice and managing expectations.

topics.title: Alien Encounters & Naked Bedtime
topics.summary: The conversation rapidly shifts between a referee’s questionable voting rights in a fight, bizarre claims of alien encounters (including a seven-foot tall creature), and shockingly candid details about the speaker's bedroom habits. The discussion involves shared TV shows with aliens, family stays, naked sleep arrangements, booby traps against extraterrestrials, and an attempt to create a waterbed canopy.

topics.title: Wealth Management and Personal Life
topics.summary: The conversation centers on the challenges of managing a large windfall after a Monopoly-like scenario, including investments, private school expenses, and personal relationships. Mark Hamill discusses his wife’s dental hygiene habits, family dynamics involving voting decisions, and an unexpected encounter with a former dental hygienist during a live broadcast.

topics.title: Howard's Buffalo Cocaine Case
topics.summary: Howard discusses a bizarre incident involving a man in Buffalo who swallowed cocaine to avoid arrest for drunk driving. The police discovered the drugs after he convulsed, leading him to sue them for $7 million due to vision impairment and brain damage – highlighting legal complexities and questionable decisions.

topics.title: Clinton Scandal Phone Records Emerge
topics.summary: State troopers revealed ongoing phone contact between Bill Clinton and one woman from 1989-1991, with records showing frequent calls. Hillary Clinton responded by accusing accusers of spreading misinformation for financial gain, reflecting public skepticism about presidential conduct.

topics.title: Legal Troubles and Personal Frustrations
topics.summary: A woman discusses her marriage difficulties and a daughter’s embarrassment while the host transitions to reporting on legal issues surrounding rapper Tupac Shakur, including past arrests and accusations of assault and sexual abuse; later, Domino Pizza drops its 30-minute delivery guarantee following a large jury award.

topics.title: Domino’s Pizza, Paul McCartney & Celebrity Mishaps
topics.summary: An employee discusses a $78 million Domino's injury settlement and Howard drives recklessly to deliver pizza while breaking speed limits. Simultaneously, the production team frantically replaces a fake panther sofa and changes an interviewer’s shoes before Paul McCartney arrives for a Paris TV event.

topics.title: Radio Broadcast Featuring Pageants & Oddities
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio broadcast, callers discuss bizarre events including a psychic friend named Nostral Domest, plans to reveal nude body with maggots during a pageant, and the potential for John Wayne Bobbitt to demonstrate his genitals on New Year’s Eve. Several listeners offer unsolicited advice regarding beauty contests and scheduling discrepancies.
